digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality sweep and J7 adapter boundary
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at the package root because Data Center backend shares it with Cloud while J7 forbids sibling-adapter imports between jira and jira_datacenter in both directions
Moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would violate the J7 seal by allowing jira_datacenter to import from jira
Moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core consumers (inbound_differ.py, peer_state.py) cannot import from that layer
The module's by-path lazy-load of adapters/jira/adf.py cannot be routed through jira_family without evading the AST contract gate
The backend-neutrality sweep exemption for inbound_fields.py must be rewritten to document this as a permanent architectural cost, not temporary relocation debt
